verdict.rationale: Maritime documents that any repo with a Dockerfile can be served on a public, no-login HTTPS URL, which lets a developer reach a service running inside a Maritime-hosted container. That is a first-party public-URL capability. However, it is framed as a web-app deployment mode, not as exposing an arbitrary port from an agent's sandbox or VM on demand. missing for 10: explicit port selection/exposure from an agent sandbox or computer, on-demand preview URL generation via CLI/API/SDK, multiple-port support, access controls on preview URLs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
